title_hi: तनाव और ध्यान: अध्ययन वास्तव में क्या मापते हैं
topic: stress exposure, subjective appraisal, attention-task behavior, EEG correlates, cortisol, alpha-amylase, timing, context, and causal limits
unique_angle: Stress is not one single attention variable; studies separate the stressor, appraisal, task behavior, physiology or EEG, timing, and sample before interpreting a result.
evidence_class: peer-reviewed stress-measurement reviews, a chronic-stress behavioral/ERP study, and a controlled acute-stress attention experiment
safety_boundary: Public education only. Stressor exposure, subjective appraisal, task behavior, physiology, EEG, timing, context, association, and causality are distinct; no biomarker or one task diagnoses a disorder, reads a private state, predicts an individual, or guarantees a result.
